description: Angular component for managing repository settings in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, validation, and interaction with backend services.

classes.name: RepositorySettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for repository settings configuration, including form management, validation, and backend interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form, sets up value change subscriptions, and loads existing repository settings if available.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks repository access using backend service and shows success notification.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current form settings to the backend and updates the component state.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes repository settings after user confirmation and resets the form.

methods.name: changePasswordChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the password change toggle, resets password field.

methods.name: changePrivateKeyPasswordChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the private key password toggle, resets private key password field.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates form validators based on selected authentication method and other state variables.
